description: This file defines the FunctionExpression class, which extends CallExpression, representing a function call node in Twig's abstract syntax tree with methods for construction and compilation.

classes.name: FunctionExpression
classes.description: Represents a function call expression node within Twig's AST, supporting construction with various function representations and compile logic with deprecation handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a FunctionExpression instance, accepting either a TwigFunction object or a string name, with deprecation warning if a string is used, and sets relevant attributes.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code from the function expression node, managing callable attributes and handling special cases like constant checks, with deprecation warnings for node modifications.
